title: Restore selected review and source links in the CI guide
body:
## Change and mathematical scope

Restore the selected proof-review and source-manifest links in the current section of `docs/ci-verification.md`. Routine registered-package planning currently fails the existing `CurrentCiNavigationTests` guard because those two links were omitted when the document moved to selected [PR #5599](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/5599). This is a one-document navigation repair; conditional κ = 0.00310045 and all scientific obligations are unchanged.

## Task and overlap

Explicit workflow repair against canonical main `df0137efd35e11b4445734bf612bdd4c7ebc330c`. The raw plan log for [PR5695](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/5695), [run 40278348787](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/actions/runs/40278348787), records exactly the missing review and source-manifest links, with package replay skipped. The same pair was reported for [PR5682](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/5682), [PR5685](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/5685) and [PR5701](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/5701). Scope is unchanged: fix their shared navigation gate without altering any research package.

## Validation

Before the repair, `python3 -B -m unittest discover -s tests -p test_research_current_status.py -v` reproduces both missing-link failure subtests. After the repair, all six tests pass on Python 3.12.3; `git diff --check` also passes. The existing test module is unchanged and still checks each selected path and file. The linked review matches its hash in the selected record, the source manifest is unchanged, and all historical CI sections are byte-identical. The full planning suite and scientific replays were not rerun locally. Previously failing hosted plans and skipped package replays remain historical outcomes until an actual hosted rerun completes.

## Credit

Preserve Ali Romman's [PR #5599](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/5599) construction, source bindings and community attribution. This is a focused navigation repair by Clear1nsight with substantial AI assistance; it makes no mathematical improvement claim.

## Open next questions

Run the hosted plan on this repair's published head. If it passes, maintainers can integrate the focused fix and arrange reruns or base updates for affected research PRs. Local navigation tests do not establish hosted package-replay acceptance.
